description: Use this when the user wants a mileage log, mileage log template, mileage log for taxes, printable mileage log, mileage log in Excel, or mileage reimbursement report from trips they drove ("turn these trips into a mileage log for my taxes", "reconstruct my mileage log from my calendar"). Takes typed trips (date, from, to, purpose, miles or odometer start/end), recurring trips (for example weekdays in a month) and/or an attached CSV/XLSX file. Applies the IRS standard mileage rate for each trip's date (2025: 70 cents; Jan-Jun 2026: 72.5 cents; Jul-Dec 2026: 76 cents per business mile; medical, moving and charity rates) or a custom employer rate, checks odometer continuity, flags commuting and missing purposes, and totals by month, purpose and client. Returns a PDF mileage log and an XLSX file. Does not look up distances between addresses, track GPS, or give tax advice. Do not use for a single quick mileage total with no trip list (use calculate_mileage_reimbursement).

custom_rate_per_mile.description: Employer or contract reimbursement rate in US dollars per mile for business trips, e.g. 0.60. Leave out to use the IRS standard mileage rate for each trip date.

driver_name.description: Optional driver name printed on the log, e.g. "Dana Lee".

file.description: Optional trip spreadsheet the user attached (CSV, TSV or XLSX) with columns such as Date, From, To, Purpose, Miles, or Odometer start and Odometer end, e.g. trips.xlsx.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

home_office_is_principal_place.description: true if the user's home office is their principal place of business (then trips from home are not flagged as commuting).

log_title.description: Title printed on the log, e.g. "October 2026 mileage".

recurring.description: Repeating trips, e.g. "every weekday in October, 18 mi to the clinic" -> [{"start_date":"2026-10-01","end_date":"2026-10-31","to":"Clinic","purpose":"Patient visits","miles":18}].

category.description: business (default), medical, moving, charity, commute or personal.

client.description: Optional client or project, e.g. "Riverside Clinic".

end_date.description: Last date of the repeat (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-31".

miles.description: Miles per occurrence as given, e.g. 18 (the round-trip total if the user says "18 mi round trip").

round_trip.description: true only if miles is one-way and should be doubled.

start_date.description: First date of the repeat, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-01".

weekdays.description: Days of the week it happens, default Monday-Friday, e.g. ["mon","wed","fri"].

regular_workplace.description: Name of the user's regular office or workplace, e.g. "Main St office", to flag home-to-office commuting.

skip_dates.description: Dates to leave out of recurring trips (holidays, PTO), YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. ["2026-10-12"].

trips.description: Typed trips, one per drive, e.g. [{"date":"2026-10-05","from":"Office","to":"Client A","purpose":"Sales meeting","miles":12.4}].

category.description: business (default), medical, moving (Armed Forces only), charity, commute (logged, not reimbursed) or personal (logged, not reimbursed).

client.description: Optional client, customer, project or property for totals by client, e.g. "Acme Corp" or "123 Oak Ln listing".

date.description: Date of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. "2026-10-05". Turn weekdays like "Mon" into real dates from the conversation.

miles.description: Miles driven as the user gives them, e.g. 12.4. If the user says "12.4 mi round trip", 12.4 is already the total: pass 12.4 with round_trip false. Leave out when odometer readings are given.

odometer_end.description: Odometer reading at the end of the trip, e.g. 41254.8. Miles = end - start.

odometer_start.description: Odometer reading at the start of the trip, e.g. 41230.

purpose.description: Business purpose (the IRS requires it), e.g. "Quarterly review meeting" or "Home visit, patient care".

round_trip.description: true only when miles is the ONE-WAY distance and the driver came back the same way ("6.2 mi each way"): miles are doubled. Ignored when odometer readings are given.

to.description: Destination (the IRS requires it), e.g. "Client A - 410 Main St, Austin TX".

vehicle.description: Optional vehicle description printed on the log, e.g. "2021 Toyota Camry". No VIN or plate needed.

year_end_odometer.description: Odometer at the end of the year (or of the log period), e.g. 52120.

year_start_odometer.description: Odometer at the start of the year (or of the log period), e.g. 38500. With year_end_odometer it gives total miles and business-use percentage.

name: generate_mileage_log
title: Generate mileage log
